tei:div.tei:p: Seek ye the Lord, while he may be found; call ye upon him while he is near. Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon. O Lord! hearken unto our voice, let thine ear attend to the voice of our supplications. Let our prayer be set forth before thee as incense.
